title: Approach OCR Target Action Schema
description: ApproachOCRTargetAction parameter definitions. Referenced by custom.action.schema.json.

target_nodes.title: Target Nodes
target_nodes.description: Recognition nodes used to locate the approach target (usually OCR nameplates). First hit wins.

stop_nodes.title: Stop Nodes
stop_nodes.description: Recognition nodes that mean the interact button / success state has appeared.

align_threshold.title: Align Threshold
align_threshold.description: Horizontal pixel threshold to treat the target as centered. Defaults to 80.

pulse_forward_ms.title: Pulse Forward Ms
pulse_forward_ms.description: Base forward pulse duration in milliseconds. Defaults to 250; farther targets get a longer pulse.

pulse_backward_ms.title: Pulse Backward Ms
pulse_backward_ms.description: Backward pulse duration when the target is already passed. Defaults to 200.

search_yaw_deg.title: Search Yaw Degrees
search_yaw_deg.description: Yaw degrees to turn when the target is not visible. Defaults to 30.

max_steps.title: Max Steps
max_steps.description: Maximum approach / search iterations. Defaults to 48.

movement.title: Movement
movement.description: Movement speed used by PlayerPulseMove. Defaults to walk.

passed_y_threshold.title: Passed Y Threshold
passed_y_threshold.description: If the target center Y is below this value, step backward. Defaults to 480.

yaw_px_per_deg.title: Yaw Pixels Per Degree
yaw_px_per_deg.description: Camera swipe pixels per yaw degree for search turns. Defaults to 2.
